personality_legacy.title: Legacy review
personality_legacy.hint: These old texts have no reliable source and are excluded from model context. Adopt only facts or character notes you explicitly approve. Old emotions cannot become current again.
personality_legacy.failed: Action failed. Your data is unchanged or the result is uncertain. Reload to check.
personality_legacy.stale: This entry changed. Reload before reviewing it again.
personality_legacy.protected: Protected note: adopt it first, then use the existing protection controls.
personality_legacy.settings: Inner Voice also enables emotion narration, V2 and the engine. A helper is recommended; the main-model fallback has strict limits. Narration expires after the configured number of turns or decay_max_age_secs, whichever comes first.
personality_legacy.deprecated: The unused error_streak_min setting is deprecated and ignored.
webauthn.title: Passkeys and security keys
webauthn.intro: Use local biometrics or a device PIN, or a FIDO2 security key. Biometric data stays on your device.
webauthn.login_passkey: Sign in with a passkey or security key
webauthn.login_second_factor: Continue with a passkey or security key
webauthn.passkey_hint: A passkey can sign you in without your password. Keep a second key or your password and authenticator code for recovery.
webauthn.second_factor_hint: Enter your password, then use a passkey or security key. If configured, your authenticator code is an alternative second factor.
webauthn.origin_hint: Use a stable DNS name and trusted HTTPS. Include the port if needed; omit paths and trailing slashes. LAN and Tailscale names do not automatically share keys.
webauthn.label: Key name
webauthn.add: Add a passkey or security key
webauthn.verify_hint: Save the domain settings first, then add a key. Enable your chosen mode afterwards and test a login in another tab while keeping this session open. These settings use their own Save button.
webauthn.remove_confirm: Remove this key? This blocks future logins with it. Existing sessions remain signed in until logout or expiry.
webauthn.reset_confirm: Changing the domain removes all registered keys. WebAuthn must be disabled first. Continue?
webauthn.unsupported: This browser or address cannot use WebAuthn. Open the configured HTTPS login address in a supported browser.
webauthn.step_up: Enter your current password and, if enabled, your current authenticator code to authorize this action.
webauthn.cancelled_or_timeout: Cancelled, timed out, or no suitable key was found. Try again or use an allowed alternative.
webauthn.origin_error: The login origin was rejected. Use the configured HTTPS address and check its certificate.
webauthn.invalid_credentials: Authentication failed. Check your password or security key.
webauthn.expired: This request expired or changed. Start a new attempt.
webauthn.save_failed: Saving failed. The new login or change was not confirmed.
webauthn.storage_error: The key registry is unavailable. Check the Vault and use an allowed alternative.
webauthn.settings_error: Check the selected mode, domain and complete HTTPS origins.
webauthn.enroll_first: Register a key before enabling WebAuthn.
webauthn.last_factor: Keep at least one usable second factor. Add another key or set up TOTP first.
webauthn.reset_required: Disable WebAuthn before changing the domain, then explicitly reset the registered keys.
webauthn.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait before trying again.
webauthn.limit: You can register up to 16 keys. Remove an unused key first.
webauthn.failed: The operation failed. Check the connection and try again.
webauthn.owner_required: Enable login protection and sign in to manage passkeys.
webauthn.uncertain: The request may have completed. Check the saved settings or key list before trying again.
common.go2rtc_source.invalid_port: {{field}} must be a number from 1 to 65535.
common.go2rtc_source.invalid_host: Enter only the IP address or host name, without port or path.
common.go2rtc_source.load_failed: Camera types could not be loaded.
common.go2rtc_source.hint_tapo: Use the TP-Link cloud password, not the RTSP password. Leave the user empty, or use admin with the uppercase MD5/SHA256 hash of the cloud password.
common.go2rtc_source.hint_kasa: User is the Kasa account e-mail. AuraGo encodes the password as go2rtc expects.
common.go2rtc_source.hint_dvrip: Leave channel and stream empty for the defaults. Only TCP is supported.
common.go2rtc_source.hint_hass: Connects to an external Home Assistant with a long-lived access token. The camera stream is rented for about five minutes at a time.
common.go2rtc_source.hint_ring: Get the device ID and refresh token from the go2rtc web interface (Add → Ring).
common.go2rtc_source.hint_nest: Needs a Google Device Access project. Only WebRTC Nest cameras are supported.
common.go2rtc_source.hint_homekit: Pair the camera in the go2rtc web interface first, then paste the homekit:// URL it shows.
common.go2rtc_source.hint_roborock: Copy the roborock:// URL from the go2rtc web interface after logging in there.
common.go2rtc_source.hint_wyze: Copy the wyze:// URL from the go2rtc web interface (Add → Wyze).
common.go2rtc_source.hint_webrtc: WebRTC sources such as WHEP, AWS Kinesis, OpenIPC or SwitchBot. See the documentation for the format option.
